verdict.summary_en: Packing list from Guangzhou PackRight for PO 4500318752, container NHMU7718206 (Yantian to Hamburg, ETD 2026-10-30). It covers 150,000 pcs of printed sleeve GH6 (part PR-SL-0604, artwork rev. B) in 300 cartons on 15 pallets, gross weight 3,600 kg. It was prepared by Lin Hui and carries a company chop. There are no handwritten corrections.
observations: Red circular company stamp (Guangzhou PackRight Packaging Co., Ltd., 出货专用章 'shipping special seal') at lower right; it contains no dates or numbers.
No document number or document date is shown; only the ETD 2026-10-30.
Prepared by: Lin Hui; no handwritten signature visible.
No buyer material ID (CMP-...) is shown; only the supplier part number PR-SL-0604.
Quantity on the packing list is not labelled as ordered or confirmed, so it cannot be compared with the PO quantity.
